- It asks about two or more listed subjects: answer the label of the one it asks about first.

request_text: Every Sunday evening I sit at the kitchen island with a cup of tea and the fridge-door calendar — and sketch out the week's dinners like a setlist, with one anchor item per night and everything else arranged around it. Our days run on soccer and piano and the school pickup shuffle — so the cupboard is where I keep the things I can reach for on the nights when the schedule goes off-tempo. All told I can spend 1450 pennies — that's the whole pot, start to finish, so every pick has to fit inside it together. This time I'm filling a gap on that shelf with something from your specialty section — a thing I can grab, open and build a whole meal around without any thawing or planning ahead. Two things go into the basket — 1 hoodie sized for teens (11-16yrs), and 2 specialty meat items that are cupboard-stored, the shelf-stable kind. The rest of the week's plan — the sides, the sauces, even which spices I pull down — hinges on what that anchor turns out to be, so I'd like help narrowing it down rather than guessing. Anything that's sold out — skip it entirely, please. No sense teasing me with a thing I can't actually order. Count on 5 messages from you — total — over the entire chat. You've got 37 steps in total — start to finish — to wrap this up.
